title: Fixed Open Hood and Angled Panel Prompting Rig
description: One newly authored complete static empty prompting-rig exterior. Two long equipment rails on four grounded pads and two full cross-ties carry a lower upward-facing blank monitor case and a separate high rear camera mounting plate. Two complete thick flared hood cheeks with true open front and rear, an overhanging roof and finite lower brackets surround one independent 45-degree finite-thickness reflector-style sheet. Two full cross-clamps and two continuous inclined edge retainers support the whole sheet. It is not a view camera with another lens, an enclosed bellows box or an old slider with a screen pasted on: all geometry is new and the low screen, angled sheet, open hood and high empty rear camera station form one integrated equipment layout. Four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up, whole horizontal-envelope-centred ground origin. One prop and zero scenes. Deliberately opaque smoked-metal reflector-style panel, not simulated transmissive glass; no optical transparency or beam-splitter function promised. No camera, displayed text, screen electronics, live reflection, prompting software, optical alignment, motion, standard fit, load, manufacturing or equipment-safety claim.
